decision: Stage 1 = research + two script versions + storyboard + voice test only; no animation or video render
why: Owner approval of the story and voice style comes before spending render time; another agent is rendering, so CPU stays light

decision: On-screen numbers limited to ~8 CM spacing, 4+ markers in view, 3+ matching points per piece
why: Only these are SOURCED in research.md from makers' docs/tutorials and university guides; marker counts and times for a whole car are UNSOURCED and sources disagree

decision: No time figure for the usual way; the wall clock has no numerals
why: Vendor case studies range 1.5 h to overnight and none is neutral; a spinning clock says 'long' without inventing a number

decision: Part B shows no 32/20 minute figures and no 'no stitching' claim; NO MARKERS and 'minutes, not hours' left as owner options
why: Owner asked R3 not to give away the real time; whether the IS350 scan needed alignment is not documented; no-markers comes from the brief and the R2 footage shows no dots, but no project note states it

decision: Scanner not named anywhere in the script
why: Host says Artec Leo on camera (speedrun transcript) but brands are owner-only in the long-form, and the reel must not name scanner brands

decision: Part B reuses V_PAIR_2, V_PAIR_3, V_MATCH_FRONT, V_RES_FULL (clean renders, not R1-R3 mp4 frames); V_MATCH_REAR is the spare
why: All exist and are verified; V_MATCH_REAR's lower 40 % is black and reads badly right after a full-frame cartoon; R2's V_RES_FULL carries the 32 MIN line baked in

decision: Voices: kristin (PIP), john (GUS), joe (SCANNER); norman, lessac-derived, ryan and hfc rejected
why: Model cards: kristin/john public domain, joe CC0 (base CC0); lessac Blizzard licence is per-licensee, ryan/hfc CC BY-NC-SA; norman babbled 6-8 s of noise on 4-word lines

decision: Version B line 1 changed from 'Quick!' to 'Hurry!'
why: faster-whisper heard the squeaky 'Quick!' as 'Click.' (WER 0.25); 'Hurry!' transcribed exactly (WER 0.00)

decision: Recommend Blender 5.3 Cycles CPU flat toon look (inverted-hull outlines, 4-8 spp, persistent data off) + Remotion text overlay; estimate 25-45 min render for 465 frames, untested
why: True cuboid characters with perspective camera moves match the block-style ask; Eevee/Workbench need OpenGL that this GPU-less container has not been checked for; Remotion-only is faster but reads as flat 2D

decision: Voices move to Higgsfield seed_audio presets (samples: Pixie, Benji +3, Mabel +2 for Pip; Bram -2, Barrett -3, Gideon for Gus), only mild pitch shifts
why: Owner: the free-engine samples all sound super weird; heavy pitch/formant shifting was the likely cause

decision: Go with script A; NO MARKERS text left out until the owner confirms it; cartoon world uses the site palette (#0b0c0b, #619f73, #ecefec)
why: Owner picked A; no project note confirms markerless scanning; owner asked for Illumaesthetic colours on R3
